text:
alex.r: Heads up: noticed a batch of failed SSE reconnects after a fast client close during rollout to eu-west. Console shows lots of 499s then immediate reconnects.

katherine: seen it too. spike at 10:24. telemetry shows duplicate route lookups before token refresh.

samir: Is this the 'fast-close' client behavior from mobile SDK? Might be clients sending FIN then reopen within 200ms.

alex.r: Yes, i captured tcp dump — quick SYN, FIN, SYN pattern. Our routing map treats each new connection as new session causing quota debit and sticky-lease churn.

megan: :eyes: Do we have a way to de-dupe reconnects in the console? It's flooding the per-route metrics.

katherine: We have `resume_window_ms` config but default is 500ms. Clients reconnect at ~150ms so we count them as new. lowering window may help but increases state retention.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1124. Affected: streaming routes in eu-west. Assigned: eng-platform.

samir: Proposal: add fast-close probation: if same client ip + token + very short gap <300ms, treat as resume and don't increment quota or route swap.

alex.r: Edge case: NATed mobile clients will change source port; token is same though. We should prefer token+session-cookie if present.

megan: console UX question: when we dedupe, how to surface in charts? show 'deduped_reconnects' series or annotate spikes?

katherine: Prefer new series so we don't silently mask real increases. Also add an annotation on rollout windows.

samir: Telemetry note: current logs only have route_id and conn_id, not prior_conn_id. Add `prev_conn_hint` to logs and trace for 1 week.

alex.r: quick patch idea: add `fast_reconnect=true` to SSE close events and don't count toward quota for 1s. We'll feature-flag it behind `ff-fast-reconnect-dedupe`.

megan: :thumbsup: can we show feature-flag state in console rollout UI? Ops folks need to see if dedupe is on.

katherine: I'll add an alert rule: if deduped_reconnects > 50% of reconnects then trigger check — might indicate client bug or ddos.

samir: Also need to update billing docs: deduped reconnects won't be billed. ping finance for wording.

alex.r: I'll open PR with config + logging. Test plan: simulate mobile jitter with client script, assert quota unchanged and previous_conn hint set.

megan: Thanks — can we roll to canary only tonight and monitor console series? I'll setup dashboard panels.

ops-bot: INC-2026-1124 updated: 'fast-reconnect' mitigation flagged for canary 02:00 UTC.

katherine: If anyone wants to run the simulator: gist: https://gist.fake/sim-reconnect -- use `--gap 150`

samir: I'll own T-shirt QA and metrics — will report back in 2 hours.
